dedupe_keys.name: innovative intersection and interchange designs and their use across the southeast dataset

description: A Southeastern United States transport research group publishes Vissim models for analysing emissions at innovative intersections. Zenodo provides the model archive free under CC BY 4.0. The deposit associates the files with a broader study of unconventional intersection safety and operation, while the file description specifically identifies the emissions-analysis models. These inputs can support microscopic simulations of vehicles and intersection control. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this model package. Coverage is the study configurations, with exact site inventory, observation periods and Vissim version not established by the public summary. Vissim software access is a separate requirement from the archive licence. Demand calibration, emission-model coupling and transfer to another intersection remain unverified. No archive was downloaded, proprietary software installed or model run.
